🚨🇲🇽 <u>One in Three Migrants Dying in ICE Custody Is Mexican</u>

Since Trump returned in January 2025, 58 foreigners have died in ICE detention or during immigration operations. 18 of them, or 31%, were Mexican. Fiscal year 2026 closed with 37 deaths in custody, the deadliest in the agency's history. Mexico's Foreign Ministry has filed 20 complaints with US prosecutors and authorities demanding sanctions.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Dos Bocas Hits 270,000 Barrels a Day</u>

The refinery they called a white elephant ran at 79.41% of its 340,000-barrel capacity in August, according to Pemex data. That's 270,000 barrels a day, the first time since commercial operations began in 2024. Output is up 163.5% from August 2025, and diesel alone reached 106,000 barrels a day, just as Washington threatens to freeze diesel exports.

🇲🇽✊ "We don't even talk about the left. We are humanists and we are Mexicans." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 5, 2026 Asked why Latin America seems to be swinging right after Bolsonaro edged out Lula in Brazil's first round, Sheinbaum said she would only speak about Mexico. "The right is a political movement, an ideology that is against the people. It defends economic interests, the supremacy of some over others, racism, classism." In Mexico, she said, it resembles the 19th-century conservatives, the Porfiriato, the war on drugs, and treating education and health as commodities. "The people of Mexico always triumph over conservative movements."
banner: "WE ARE HUMANISTS AND WE ARE MEXICANS"

text: 🚨🇲🇽 "It is very important to expose it and to say it, because if not, it becomes something normal, and it is not normal." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 5, 2026 Over the weekend, Querétaro governor Mauricio Kuri invited US Ambassador Ronald Johnson to lay the first stone of an international police training academy. The Defense Ministry, the federal Security Cabinet and the Foreign Ministry were not invited. "Any agency, any institution of the United States that wants to train in Mexico for security reasons has to go through the Foreign Ministry and the National Security Law." Sheinbaum asked the Foreign Minister to call both the ambassador and the governor. Did Kuri break the law? "Not so far, but it has to be named and said."
banner: US POLICE ACADEMY: FOREIGN MINISTRY BYPASSED

text: 🚨🇲🇽 "There are very right-wing groups in that government that don't like Mexico and that seek a change of government in Mexico." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 5, 2026 A reporter noted that Brazil's left had denounced US intervention in its elections and asked if the US could try to intervene in Mexico's 2030 presidential election. "The international right does, yes, it wants to intervene; we have been denouncing it constantly." Of the Trump government, she said it is "not necessarily the President." Her answer: "The only defense is the people, the only one," along with spreading the benefits of the Fourth Transformation and "not zigzagging," as López Obrador used to say.

🇲🇽✊ "Women are not guests of the transformation, we are its protagonists." — Alma Lilia Ruiz Bautista, Tejedora de la Patria, Oaxaca "In a context of external challenges and pressures, women's organization is key to defending the freedom and sovereignty of our homeland." The Tejedoras de la Patria volunteer network now has 197,446 women. The Women's Ministry reported 27 million copies of the women's rights booklet, in 56 Indigenous languages, and 100 Centros LIBRE in all 32 states, with 1.4 million services provided. The goal is one in each of Mexico's nearly 2,500 municipalities. The 079 option 1 hotline has received about 20,000 calls.

🇲🇽🚆 "We are doing our part. We are not sitting with our arms crossed, as it was before, waiting to see who would invest." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 5, 2026 Every major public work of the administration is being tendered now as a multi-year project, so construction runs through 2030 without the usual early-year slowdown. "All the trains are tendered this year," along with highways and water works. The IMF raised its growth forecast for Mexico, and vehicle sales are up more than 8%. The housing chamber told Sheinbaum developers are so busy with the Vivienda para el Bienestar program that "there is even a shortage of labor in some states."
